chunks: Then his passion induced him to murder his brother, so he killed him, and he became one of the losers.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the consequence of killing a soul unjustly?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the internal struggle where the ego (nafs) becomes the primary instigator of sin, leading Qabil to commit the first fratricide. The designation 'of the losers' underscores the spiritual bankruptcy resulting from failing to restrain base desires, a concept central to the Shia understanding of self-purification (tazkiyah).
